title: A Permutation Avoidance Game with Reverse Replies and Monotone Traps
summary: We study the impartial game PAP (``permutations avoiding patterns''), in which players take turns choosing patterns to avoid. We define a set of length $k$ patterns, $B_k$, and show that it is the unique minimal monotone-forcing subset of $S_k$: every sufficiently long permutation that avoids $B_k$ is monotone, and every monotone-forcing subset of $S_k$ must contain $B_k$. We prove a quadratic upper bound for the monotone-forcing threshold, and determine the exact thresholds for $k=3,4,5,6$.
